step1_analysis.description: A continuous-time common-mode feedback circuit that detects the common-mode voltage of a fully differential amplifier and generates a control voltage to regulate it. It uses parallel differential pairs or triode-operated tail currents to achieve common-mode detection while inherently rejecting differential signals.

paper_reference.title: Continuous-Time Common-Mode Feedback for High-Speed Switched-Capacitor Networks

sky130_expected.calculation: Gain is determined by the transconductance of the input/tail network and the output resistance of the PMOS loads. Assuming gm ~ 100uS and Rout ~ 100kOhm, Gain = gm * Rout = 10 V/V = 20 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches the lower gain value reported in the paper, typical for a single-stage CMFB error amplifier.

sky130_expected.calculation: Due to the symmetric cross-connection of the input pairs (XM7A-D), differential signals cancel out at the output nodes.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ideally zero (-infinity dB), but limited by numerical precision and any slight asymmetries in simulation.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rout * Cload). With Rout ~ 100kOhm and Cload = 150fF, BW ~ 10.6 MHz. Without explicit load, parasitic capacitance dominates, pushing BW higher.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The paper targets high-speed operation, reporting frequencies around 72-100 MHz.

sky130_expected.calculation: Two PMOS loads biased at VBP1=0.99V. |Vov| = 1.8 - 0.99 - 0.42 = 0.39V. Id ~ 37.5uA each. Total current ~ 75uA. Power = 1.8V * 75uA = 135uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Calculated based on the provided bias voltages and SKY130 typical parameters.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure common-mode gain, differential-mode rejection, bandwidth, and power consumption of the CMFB circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Continuous-Time CMFB Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm7a=5u L_xm7a=0.5u
.param W_xm7b=5u L_xm7b=0.5u
.param W_xm7c=5u L_xm7c=0.5u
.param W_xm7d=5u L_xm7d=0.5u
.param W_xm8_l=5u L_xm8_l=0.5u
.param W_xm8_r=5u L_xm8_r=0.5u
.param W_xm9_l=5u L_xm9_l=0.5u
.param W_xm9_r=5u L_xm9_r=0.5u

* DUT
XM7A TO_CMFB_MINUS VOUT_MINUS N3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7a} w={W_xm7a}
XM7B TO_CMFB_PLUS VOUT_MINUS N3 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7b} w={W_xm7b}
XM7C TO_CMFB_MINUS VOUT_PLUS N1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7c} w={W_xm7c}
XM7D TO_CMFB_PLUS VOUT_PLUS N1 VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7d} w={W_xm7d}
XM8_L TO_CMFB_MINUS VBP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8_l} w={W_xm8_l}
XM8_R TO_CMFB_PLUS VBP1 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm8_r} w={W_xm8_r}
XM9_L N3 VBN2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9_l} w={W_xm9_l}
XM9_R N1 VBN2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm9_r} w={W_xm9_r}

* DC Sources
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VVSS VSS 0 0
VVBP1 VBP1 0 0.99
VVBN2 VBN2 0 0.54

* Input Signals (Common-Mode and Differential-Mode)
VCM_ac VCM_node 0 dc 0.9 ac 1 pulse(0.9 1.0 1n 1n 1n 50n 100n)
VDM_ac VDM_node 0 dc 0 ac 0

* Voltage-controlled voltage sources to generate VOUT_PLUS and VOUT_MINUS
E1 VOUT_PLUS 0 vol='v(VCM_node) + 0.5*v(VDM_node)'
E2 VOUT_MINUS 0 vol='v(VCM_node) - 0.5*v(VDM_node)'

* Load Capacitance (simulating the main amplifier's bias node)
Cload1 TO_CMFB_PLUS 0 150f
Cload2 TO_CMFB_MINUS 0 150f

.control
  * DC Operating Point
  op
  let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(TO_CMFB_PLUS) v(TO_CMFB_MINUS)

  * Common-Mode AC Analysis
  ac dec 20 1 1G
  let cm_gain = vdb(TO_CMFB_PLUS)
  meas ac cm_gain_1k find cm_gain at=1k
  let cm_gain_3db = cm_gain_1k - 3
  meas ac cm_bw when cm_gain=cm_gain_3db fall=1

  * Differential-Mode AC Analysis
  alter VCM_ac ac=0
  alter VDM_ac ac=1
  ac dec 20 1 1G
  let dm_gain = vdb(TO_CMFB_PLUS)
  meas ac dm_gain_1k find dm_gain at=1k

  * Transient Analysis (Common-Mode Step Response)
  tran 0.1n 100n
  meas tran v_out_max max v(TO_CMFB_PLUS)
  meas tran v_out_min min v(TO_CMFB_PLUS)
  
  quit
.endc
